With 18 boats, over 100 team members and locations in Vancouver, Victoria and Telegraph Cove, Prince of Whales Whale & Marine Wildlife Adventures is proudly the largest whale watching company in British Columbia. We can offer both private whale watching charters and special custom charters. Delivery trips up the coast, weddings, celebrations of life, company retreats, tour groups and day cruises, custom pickup and drop-off locations outside of our three central locations, THE POSSIBILITIES ARE ENDLESS, as always it never hurts to ask 😉

blurb: Guests board vessels in downtown Victoria to watch for whales such as Orcas and Humpbacks, as well as other marine wildlife. Tours run year-round with a 95% whale sighting success rate and a free return trip if no whales are seen. The company emphasizes sustainability and education about marine ecosystems.
